topic.title: Comment on the final evaluation for this competition

comments.content: @macruzbar thanks for info. As far as I understand the polepositioning for Tournament will be determined by two weeks episodes? Am I right? Or the rankings will be reset?

Kaggle competition team: Could you confirm whether any official correction or grace procedure is available for an agent uploaded just after the final submission deadline?

Team: CemBas (16672315). Build 413 was ready before the 23:59 UTC deadline on September 30, 2026, but my AI assistant delayed the upload while waiting for approval. Kaggle accepted submission 56722609 on October 1 at 00:01:38.383 UTC and 56722626 at 00:01:55.320 UTC. Additional late submission 56724845 was accepted at 00:05:03.663 UTC.

All three have completed validation but are marked disabled by the active submission limit. The API still lists 56707992 (Build 307) and 56694653 (Build 301) as active.

Is there any organizer-approved way to correct the final entry? If not, could you confirm that these late uploads are excluded from final competition evaluation?

Thanks for clarifying the final evaluation. Two questions on the Bradley-Terry tournament:

  1. Will the tournament be fit on only the episodes played oct 1-15 oct, or on the full episode history including pre-deadline games?
  2. Are ties counted as half a win, and is the first regularised in any way?
@macruzbar thanks for info. As far as I understand the polepositioning for Tournament will be determined by two weeks episodes? Am I right? Or the rankings will be reset? i have same question.
